data.title: 爱蜜莉雅 · 晨光寝宫
data.description: 清晨温暖的金色阳光洒在大床上，爱蜜莉雅光着身子坐在床沿慢吞吞地揉着睡眼，薄被滑落露出纤细柔美的腰线与白皙后背——「唔……早安，昴。昨晚梦到了很长很温暖的梦呢……今天也请继续留在我身边哦。」
data.action: 清晨坐在床沿揉睡眼，薄被滑落露出纤细后背与双峰
data.camera: side view, medium shot, horizontal framing
data.promptProse: Seated at the bed edge with the sheet slipped to her hips, she rubs one sleepy eye while gathering the fabric between her thighs. Warm golden morning sunlight falls across the bed.
data.animaCaption: She gathers the sheet between her thighs while rubbing one eye.
